Kikiri kwega: %1$s ahari %2$s · ebindi waataho chaaji
Byegirwe %1$s ahari %2$s kuhitsya hati · ebyazoorwa ebindi nibibaasa kureebeka
Enyima y\'erangi y\'orupapura rw\'obushuushu n\'erangi emwe y\'omuhondo, nikyorobi kushoma omu mushana gw\'amaani.
Etwara amabara gaayo omu kishushani kyawe ky\'enyima, kandi gahinduka nakyo kyahinduka.
